## Definition
The application of the Free Energy Principle to network topologies, where the system minimizes variational free energy by adjusting its structural connectivity to better predict sensory inputs. This provides a theoretical basis for optimizing TCC interconnect topologies to reduce prediction errors in distributed neuromorphic processing.
